title: An adder from gates
description:
Build a 4-bit adder from logic gate functions.

```
  0101 (5)
+ 0011 (3)
= 1000 (8), carry out 0
```
hints: A full adder: `s1, c1 = half_adder(a, b)`, `s2, c2 = half_adder(s1, carry_in)`, carry out is `c1 or c2` (lesson 4.02).
Keep bits in lists with index 0 as the lowest bit, so the carry moves from index 0 upwards.
requirements: `full_adder(a, b, carry_in)` is built from two half adders and an `or`.
`add4(a_bits, b_bits)` chains four full adders (ripple carry), lowest bit first.
No `+` on numbers inside the gates.
stretch: Count how many gates the 4-bit adder uses, and how many an 8-bit one would.
